teaser: A minimal publishing profile built on Quanta CMS.
author: administrator
body:
Quanta Journal is a ready-to-use blog profile designed around readable typography, simple navigation and a focused article archive.

Replace this copy with your own introduction, edit the sample posts, and start publishing. The profile uses Quanta's existing BLOG, CONTENT, MENU and navigation Qtags, so no custom application code is required.
title: About the journal
